scope.contract: Original immutable I-005 and s3 delete/ripple rows. This slice opens only RippleDeleteClips for a single continuous range R defined by the complete link and selection closure. Ripple trim and closing a move source hole are not implemented and are not claimed. Existing reject, overwrite and insert collision modes stay distinct; LiftClips and the workbench Delete (leave gap) button remain lift. DeleteClip(ripple:true) is unchanged and still raises LINKED_RIPPLE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED on persistent-audio/linked AV. New-track creation, cross-project bake and the OS clipboard are not implemented.
scope.temporalSemantics: R is the merged union of the expanded closure; touching or overlapping intervals merge, a remaining gap raises RIPPLE_RANGE_NOT_CONTIGUOUS. One R is applied to all participating tracks (default: targets union syncLock media; an explicit rippleTrackIds list cannot drop targets or include a caption track). Split the later bound b first, then a, so coordinates stay stable. Items fully inside [a,b) are removed; unselected items that span the bounds keep front and back remnants with remapped sources and opacity; later items on ripple tracks shift by -L. Sequence duration shrinks by L, but not below later ends on unmoved non-ripple tracks. Assets and blobs are not deleted. Remnants are not auto-joined.
scope.preserved: Link closure is complete (includeLinks=true). Source time, cropped opacity curves, static effects, proxy/asset version refs and audio offsets are preserved. Locks on written fields raise FIELD_LOCKED; a locked syncLock non-target that would crop or shift raises SYNC_LOCKED. Whole-group atomic refusal, never a silent subset. Transitions with a cut strictly inside (a,b) or whose endpoints vanish or lose adjacency are dropped; cuts at or after b remap via the end-split map and subtract L. Absolute captions that would have to crop or shift (cue end > a) refuse CAPTION_SYNC_EDIT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED; caption cue-follow/anchor policy is not opened.
scope.history: Each ripple delete is one existing persistent command with snapshot undo/redo, save/reopen, archive fork and AAC MP4 export. No new persistence schema or fingerprint side branch.
scope.ui: Workbench adds Ripple delete range (key ripple-delete). Existing Key(delete) is unchanged and still leave-gap when persistent audio is present. SQL/commit failures on _act edit buttons now surface as LOCAL_COMMIT_FAILED instead of an unhandled exception. UI tests jump foundation-scroll and do not drag through the pointer timeline.
